content_text: With regard to the budget, we have spent about sixty percent so far and the remaining funds should be sufficient for the final phase. The client feedback from the soft launch has been overwhelmingly positive, which is a great sign. I would suggest we schedule a review meeting early next week to go over the remaining action items and align on priorities. Let me know if that works for you. Thanks for your continued support on this project.
